result.rationale: In embeddable_hosts_controller.rb, `EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` can return nil for an unknown id; `update` then passes nil to save_host which calls `host.host = ...`, and `destroy` calls `host.destroy` on nil — both producing NoMethodError 500s. Also `params[:embeddable_host]` is dereferenced without a presence check. Verifiable directly from the diff.
